genre.about: the world the image is set in. Context with no genre given is realistic, so a value tagged only fantasy is out of a plain prompt.

era.about: when the image is set. early_modern is roughly 1500-1799. Context with no era given is contemporary.

locale.about: what kind of place around the subject

time_of_day.about: the time of day the scene implies

presentation.about: gendered presentation, only for values that are clearly gendered in images

age.about: the age of the person, only for values that clearly don't fit every age

formality.about: how dressed-up an outfit or place is

budget.about: how expensive a place or outfit looks

region.about: a cultural region, only for values that are culturally specific (a tatami room, a sari)
